BiblicalUsage: Once, in the cities of Judah: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah. The name is a town in the south, counted among the cities of the tribe, and the count is all the Bible says of it.
TheologicalSignificance: A town named once in a list carries no lesson of its own. What it shows is the inheritance measured town by town, that even the small towns of the south are named.
